title: Play the radio
summary: Plays a live radio station through the AI Radio applet: a station the person names (KEXP, NPR) or the best station for a genre or place.
whenToUse: Use when the person asks to play or listen to the radio, a station or a kind of radio.

arguments.name: query
arguments.description: The station, genre or place they said, such as 'KEXP' or 'jazz'

_note: Phase AV.22 (2026-11-12): the AI Radio applet for the agent, through its own service.
